operationInterrupted: The previous dubbing operation stopped before completion was confirmed. Saved text and cue audio are retained. Check the results before synthesizing or exporting again.
operationReceiptFailed: The operation returned a result, but its recovery receipt could not be saved. Check the disk and reopen the project: {{error}}
configSaveFailed: Dubbing settings were not saved. Changes are retained; retry before generating or exporting.
configDraftFound: This project has dubbing settings without a save confirmation.
configDraftUnreadable: The project settings draft could not be read. The original record is retained.
pageDesc: Subtitle + optional video → per-line TTS → timeline alignment → export
emptyStep1Desc: SRT / VTT / ASS and more; add a video to replace or mix its audio track and preview the result
emptyStep2: Choose a voice and start dubbing
emptyStep2Desc: Pick an engine and voice on the left, preview it, then synthesize line by line
emptyStep3Desc: Audition and fix lines in the list on the right, then export the final result in one click
emptyDropHint: You can also drag subtitle/video files into this page
emptyCueList: Cue list appears here after loading a subtitle
noEngineHint: No engine available: download a local dubbing model or configure an online provider in TTS Services
edgeUnstableHint: Edge free channel is a reverse-engineered API with no availability guarantee. Switch to a local model or an OpenAI-compatible provider if it breaks.
voicePreviewPreparing: Preparing a preview of up to 3 seconds. Move away or press Stop to cancel.
voicePreviewHint: Hover over a voice to preview up to 3 seconds. The first preview may take a moment to generate.
localConcurrencyHint: Each parallel lane keeps an extra model in memory (~0.5GB regular, ~1.5GB clone models); reclaimed automatically after the batch
cloneQualityHint: High quality roughly doubles synthesis time, noticeable for batch dubbing
backgroundDuck: Duck original track (auto lower during speech)
outputLockedHint: No video provided (or the media is audio-only), so only audio export is available
overlapModeHint: {{count}} line(s) overlap in time: defer plays them in order; multi-track mix keeps the original timeline and mixes them at export
charBillingCloud: Cloud TTS bills per character; previews and per-line regeneration cost extra
charBillingAzure: Azure billing includes SSML markup characters, slightly above this count
charBillingEleven: ElevenLabs bills Chinese at ~3 characters per character (byte-based)
charBillingVolc: Doubao character tier ~¥1.3 per 1K chars, free quota for new users
exportSkipped: {{count}} line(s) without synthesis were skipped (kept silent)

inspector.label: Dub review · {{index}} of {{total}}
inspector.releaseAllDesc: {{count}} file(s) will skip review and continue to composing (this may take a while).

sessionRestored: Restored previous dubbing progress: {{done}}/{{total}} lines complete
staleSessionDesc: This subtitle file differs from when it was last dubbed, so synthesized lines cannot be restored. Rebuilding will re-dub from the new subtitle (previous results are discarded).
overlongExportHint: Resolve {{count}} overlong line(s) by shortening or borrowing following silence before exporting.
shortenTimeout: AI shortening timed out. Original text and audio are unchanged. Retry.
shortenNotShorter: AI did not return shorter text. Original text and audio are unchanged.
overlapHint: {{count}} line(s) overlap in time (auto deferred in order)
speakerVoicesDesc: Choose one voice per speaker; individual lines can still override it.
speakerVoiceRequired: Choose a voice for this speaker before starting batch dubbing.
speakerVoiceConflict: Speaker assignments were merged and have conflicting old voices. Choose one again.
voiceUnavailableHint: The current engine does not provide the previously selected voice. Choose another voice.
cueSpeakerOverlap: Multiple speakers overlap; only one line is generated with the primary speaker voice
staleAudioHint: {{count}} lines have outdated text, language or synthesis settings and cannot be exported yet.
staleExportDesc: {{count}} lines have outdated text, language or synthesis settings. Regenerate them before exporting.
speakerSettingsConflict: Merged roles have different speed/pitch settings. Choose one.
sessionLocked: This dubbing project is in use by another window or pipeline. The latest state will load when it is released.
configSelectionRequired: Select a dubbing engine and voice before saving.
savedEngineUnavailable: Saved engine {{engine}} is unavailable. Restore it or choose another engine.
savedVoiceUnavailable: Saved voice {{voice}} is unavailable. Restore it or choose another voice.
cueDraftUnreadable: Text draft could not be read
insufficientSilence: Not enough following silence. Edit the text or speed and regenerate.
